milestones.title: Iceberg V3 by default
milestones.body: New tables are format-version 3. A JSON column is stored as an Iceberg VARIANT and reads back as JSON text; shredded variant files written by other engines (Spark) are read on the coordinator and on workers. Merge-on-read DELETE writes deletion vectors, and compaction triggers on the deleted-row share. Row lineage is maintained at write time, and V3 unknown columns are supported. Rescored against the current Iceberg matrix rubric: ${matrix.score.raw}/${matrix.score.max} (${matrix.score.percent}%).

milestones.title: MCP, governed by the caller's own token
milestones.body: SQE speaks Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP from the same coordinator binary, off by default. It is an OAuth resource server rather than a credential proxy: the caller's bearer becomes the same per-user session Flight SQL uses and travels to the catalog and storage unchanged, so an assistant reads exactly what its human can read. The read-only SQL tool is gated by SQE's own parser as an allow-list, and the write tool needs an OAuth scope, an engine role, and source authorization independently.

milestones.title: Read-only ops web UI
milestones.body: A network-gated dashboard ships inside the coordinator binary, live queries with per-fragment timing, cluster workers, and engine metrics with 12h history (sparklines, gauges, a query-activity histogram). No login, no build step, no external assets.

milestones.title: One distributed engine
milestones.body: After driving an Apache Ballista integration to functional parity and measuring it honestly, slower where it completed, couldn't finish the TPC-DS analytical core, we removed it. The bespoke scheduler (weighted placement, scan locality, straggler handling) is the only distributed engine.

milestones.title: Security & correctness audit
milestones.body: A multi-wave audit campaign hardened the stack: a sealed secret type, per-user session isolation and cache keying, policy correctness on DELETE/UPDATE, write-path cleanup on cancel, and constant-time credential checks. Every audit finding resolved.

milestones.title: DuckDB-class embedded mode
milestones.body: File-format table functions (read_parquet / csv / json), SELECT * FROM 'file' auto-detect, COPY … TO, and HuggingFace hf:// URLs. The embedded persona that turned out DuckDB-shaped.

milestones.title: Column-level lineage
milestones.body: A native OpenLineage 2-0-2 emitter with column-level lineage on writes. File and HTTP sinks, disk-spool fallback for collector outages. Off by default.

milestones.title: Five catalogs, live-verified
milestones.body: Apache Polaris, Project Nessie, Unity Catalog OSS, AWS Glue, and AWS S3 Tables, each behind live integration tests. AWS SigV4 support added to the vendored REST catalog for federated endpoints.

milestones.title: Runtime filter pushdown
milestones.body: DataFusion 53 runtime filters from hash-join build sides now feed the Iceberg scan's row-group, page-index, and row-filter pruning, double-digit TPC-H speedups at SF1 and SF10.

milestones.title: DataFusion 53.1 + vendored Iceberg fork
milestones.body: ~40x faster planning, hash-join dynamic filters, and three filter-pushdown fixes. A vendored iceberg-rust fork rebased on DataFusion 53 with a SigV4 feature for federated REST.

milestones.title: Iceberg matrix: 52% -> 88.4%
milestones.body: Phased coverage work lifted the public Iceberg matrix score from a 52% baseline to 88.4% (167/189, on the rubric of the time): V3 features end to end, partition evolution, merge-on-read deletes, bloom filters, and live catalog verification.
